title: S0764 (2019 Regular): Home Safety

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-02-06; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2019/764/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 1893754))
provenance.note: Introduced version (filed 2019-02-06); no passage vote. Exceptions in (2): locked container, safe or trunk; firearm safety device; locking device; or kept readily accessible to the owner. Section 2 also adds yearly clerk-of-court reporting on risk protection orders to the State Courts Administrator (not quoted).

operative_text:
Section 1 (new s. 790.1741, F.S.): (1) PROHIBITION.—Unless an exception under subsection (2) applies, a person who is 18 years of age or older, who is a legal occupant of a residence, and who owns a firearm may not keep in that residence a firearm if he or she knows or has reason to know that another person also residing therein is prohibited by state or federal law from owning, possessing, purchasing, or receiving a firearm.
Section 1 (new s. 790.1741, F.S.): (3) PENALTY.—A person who violates this section commits a misdemeanor of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.
Section 2 (s. 790.401, F.S.): (2)(a) A petition for a risk protection order may be filed by a law enforcement officer, a law enforcement agency, or a family or household member.
